questions.question: To whom does the earth and its fullness belong?
Who may ascend the hill of the LORD?
options: He who brings the very richest of offerings
He who is wealthy and honored by men
He who is mighty and strong in war
He who has clean hands and a pure heart
questions.answer: He who has clean hands and a pure heart

questions.question: The psalm calls the gates to lift up their heads that the King of glory may come in.
Who is this King of glory? The LORD, strong and _____.
The earth is the LORD's and the _____ thereof.
